calls.title: Dmitry + Christian (GrowthBook)
calls.summary: In this sales call, Dmitry (head of a future Uzbekistan-based classified platform with 6 million MAU) discussed migrating from an internal A/B testing platform to GrowthBook’s on-premises enterprise solution, citing needs for advanced server-side traffic splitting, authentication, and cost management. Christian Liebenow (GrowthBook) explained enterprise features like SSO, advanced statistics, and data cost optimization, pricing at $1,000/user/year with a 10-user minimum. Next steps: Dmitry will first trial the open-source version and contact Christian for enterprise licensing as the company scales
